run_forward_early: run forward_early to perform a partial LLM forward pass exiting at a specified layer
run_forward_remainder: run forward_remainder to complete a speculative decoding pass using cached early-exit hidden states
run_forward: run forward to perform a standard autoregressive forward pass through a LlamaForCausalLM model
decode_next_token: decode the next token from logits using greedy or sampled decoding with top-k and top-p filtering
filter_logits_top_k_top_p: filter logits using top-k and top-p nucleus sampling to reduce the candidate token distribution
